verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Navan offers travel booking, corporate card connection, receipt scanning, and expense management as separate features. Nothing documents trip bookings, card transactions, and receipts being automatically gathered into a single report tied to a trip itinerary. These neighbouring features do not establish the story's capability.

support.subject: As an employee, a trip's expenses — bookings, cards, receipts — collect themselves into one itinerary-linked report
